name: autosketch
description: Build Minecraft schematics with an agent, using blocks and textures from your own modded instance.
long_description:
Autosketch reads blocks, shapes and textures from your own Minecraft instance (vanilla or modded; no game assets are shipped) and gives the agent high-level build actions, renders, slices and palette sheets. Results export to Axiom blueprints, Sponge `.schem` and Create `.nbt`.

Choose your instance below, or leave it empty: the server then opens a setup page in your browser listing the instances it found in your launchers' folders.

In-game requests through the companion mod need Claude Code channels, which Claude Desktop doesn't have; building and the live world link work.

instance.title: Minecraft instance
instance.description: The instance folder to read blocks from (for CurseForge: …/curseforge/minecraft/Instances/<pack>). Leave empty to choose in the setup page instead.
